title: Smart Gas Meter IoT Telemetry v2 (bench firmware)
description: Records produced by the ESP32-S3 bench firmware (firmware/) and its host simulator. Adds record types, billing-period self-reading, events and link diagnostics to v1. Pulse counts are raw; volume needs a verified meter-specific pulse constant. Bench data only: not certified metrology.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing per device across reboots (persisted in flash before a record is queued).

timestamp.description: UTC, ends in Z. For period_close it is the period boundary when the device observed it on time.

uptime_ms.description: Milliseconds since the current boot; resets on every reboot.

pulse_count_total.description: Cumulative qualified pulses, persisted across reboots.

time_source.description: backfilled = created before the clock was known; time derived from uptime after sync.

period.description: Required when record_type is period_close: the billing period that just closed.
